# ProxiPilot

> Autonomous Multi-Tenant AI Email Automation Platform with Vector RAG.

ProxiPilot connects to enterprise email providers (Gmail, Microsoft Outlook) and autonomously drafts, reviews, and executes customer email workflows grounded in company knowledge with zero hallucination.

## Core Capabilities
- **Email Synchronization**: Bidirectional real-time OAuth sync for Gmail and Microsoft Outlook with incremental cursor polling and webhook fallbacks.
- **Enterprise Knowledge RAG**: Multi-category document ingestion (Excel, PDF, CSV) indexed in Qdrant vector database with hybrid semantic + BM25 lexical ranking.
- **Evidence-Gated Reply Planner**: Proprietary planner that inspects retrieved facts, matches conversation intents, and strictly rejects speculative answers.
- **Transactional Outbox & Memory**: Outbox relay pattern for idempotent email dispatch, combined with persistent multi-turn thread memory and client style profile calibration.
- **Multi-Tenant Security**: Cryptographic tenant isolation, role-based access control (RBAC), and SOC 2 ready compliance.
